basic_info.description: Perched on the top floor of a classic 1920s building in prime Russian Hill, this rare 2BD/1BA TIC offers approximately 947 square feet of light-filled living space and stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge, the Bay, and the city.     This residence seamlessly blends timeless character with modern convenience. A gracious formal entryway lined with arched windows welcomes you into the home, setting the tone with abundant natural light and classic charm. Inside, you'll find hardwood floors, period molding, and an original fireplace that anchors the inviting living area.    Modern upgrades include a washer/dryer in-unit, a well-appointed kitchen, and access to a shared rooftop deck with panoramic views. The building offers a secure street gate with intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway.    This home has parking available for an additional cost. With a stellar 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from Russian Hill's beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, cable cars, and MUNI bus routes. A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and HOA financials are professionally managed by HOMworks.    Experience quintessential San Francisco living with iconic views in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.
